summary.text: Dave Rustebakke is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 20 (Larimore) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dave Rustebakke's service as "House since 2026". The member page lists Dave Rustebakke's committee assignments as including the Government Finance Committee (interim).
